baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمَانَ ... مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The prior community actively makes a joint habitat: an enclosing dwelling and a condition of trust are established before the migrants arrive. Love is therefore not only an attitude toward newcomers but the receiving capacity of an already prepared social place.

activation_trace.role: Taking or preparing a lodging supplies the active establishment of the receiving habitat.
Circular enclosure supplies the dwelling's bounded spatial form and its capacity to hold a community.
Security and settled trust make faith the affective counterpart of the physical dwelling.
Departure from one dwelling to another supplies the displaced people whom the dual habitat receives.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies residents who already possessed a home and faith and then welcomed migrants.
changed_reading.after: The verse portrays settlement and faith as deliberately prepared, spatial-and-affective infrastructure capable of receiving people displaced from another home.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا يَجِدُونَ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِمَّا أُوتُوا وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence joins an absent inward claim to an outward reversal of priority. What others receive leaves no lodged residue of need in the action-producing interior; the hosts then choose the others over themselves even while a real deficit remains in their own condition.

activation_trace.role: The interior source from which actions issue makes the breast the mechanism's control point, not decorative emotion-language.
A negated trace that does not remain in the breast supplies the removal of an inward claim on what others received.
Choosing another in preference supplies the explicit reversal from self-priority to other-priority.
Poverty as a breach in one's condition keeps the preference costly rather than surplus disposal.

changed_reading.before: The hosts avoid envy and generously give despite being poor.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes a two-stage redistribution mechanism: an inward entitlement fails to lodge, then priority is actively reversed while the giver's own deficit remains real.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Scarcity activates a self that competes for what is valued, while shuh couples withholding to acquisitive pressure. The passive protection formula treats release from that loop as being guarded from an internal hazard; flourishing names the durable success of that protection.

activation_trace.role: A valuable object over which selves compete supplies the acquisitive pressure located within the self.
A barrier that repels harm frames deliverance from shuh as protection from a damaging inner mechanism.
Withholding joined to avid desire identifies the hazard as more than simple reluctance to spend.
Attained good, survival, and rescue supply the outcome of escaping the retention loop.

changed_reading.after: Flourishing belongs to people protected from a self-reinforcing inner system of competitive desire and withholding, especially when scarcity would normally intensify it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared dwelling-and-trust habitat becomes a counter-displacement institution. Expulsion removes people from homes, concentrated circulation threatens to trap resources among the rich, and impoverished migrants arrive after leaving another dwelling; 59:9 answers by making resident space and trust receivable rather than exclusive.

activation_trace.role: Prepared lodging anchors the changed reading in the hosts' active making of a receiving place.
Security and trust make reception social and affective as well as spatial.
Penetration to the outside supplies the preceding forced loss of inhabited place that reception reverses.
A turn circulating among hands supplies the distribution problem that an open receiving habitat must interrupt.
Need and lack of means identify the migrants' material exposure rather than an abstract category of outsiders.
Movement from one dwelling to another links the displaced poor directly to the migrants received in 59:9.

structural_cues: 59:2 expels people from dwellings; 59:7 blocks wealth from circulating only among the rich; 59:8 names poor migrants; 59:9 then establishes dwelling, trust, love, and preference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, anti-concentration, impoverished migration, and prepared lodging. I infer that the hosts' dual habitat functionally repairs displacement. A live alternative is that these are adjacent virtues without an institutional causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The settled residents offer admirable hospitality to newcomers.
changed_reading.after: Their dwelling-and-trust arrangement repairs a prior process of expulsion by converting settled residence and distributed resources into access for displaced people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapping of يُؤْثِرُونَ activates not only choosing another but stirring something from its place. Against repeated return and the warning about circulation restricted to wealthy hands, preference can be carried as a transfer operation: goods are dislodged from the resident self's priority and rerouted toward another.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of stirring a thing from its place supplies an exploratory kinetic layer to preference.
Return and turning back supply the incoming resource movement that can be redirected rather than arrested.
Alternation among hands and conditions supplies the circulation frame in which preference moves priority outward.

structural_cues: The repeated return formula in 59:6-7 leads into the prohibition on rich-only circulation, followed by the recipients in 59:8 and the act of preference in 59:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a form-distant ء ث ر-to-ث و ر branch, returning property, and circulation among hands. I infer a directional arrow from self-priority to outward resource movement. The live alternative is the dominant lexical reading of preference without any kinetic nuance.

changed_reading.before: Preference is an ethical ranking in which another person is chosen first.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, preference is also the act that dislodges a resource from self-priority and keeps returned wealth moving toward exposed others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absence of need in the breasts becomes an architecture of cohesion. Later contrasts show hidden rancor lodged in hearts, fear contracted in breasts, and people apparently gathered behind walls while their hearts remain scattered. The hosts' real dwelling is therefore not enclosure alone: its interior is kept free of rival claims that would fragment the gathered body.

activation_trace.role: The breast as the origin of action anchors cohesion or fragmentation in an operative interior.
A negated residue in the breast supplies the clean interior against which lodged rancor is contrasted.
Concealed rancor lodged in the chest supplies the latent rival force explicitly excluded from communal interiors.
Fear with contraction supplies an alternative occupant of breasts that deforms collective action.
Joining dispersed parts into one supplies the apparent collective form whose truth is tested at heart level.
A raised wall supplies external enclosure that can hide rather than create inner unity.
Dispersion supplies the interior failure that persists despite visible gathering and walls.

structural_cues: 59:9 places no need in breasts; 59:10 excludes rancor from hearts; 59:13 places contracted fear in breasts; 59:14 opposes visible gathering and walls to scattered hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clean or burdened interiors, apparent gathering, walls, and scattered hearts. I infer that inward non-claim is what converts residence into cohesive community. A live alternative is that each heart image diagnoses a separate group without defining 59:9's habitat.

changed_reading.before: The hosts simply feel no envy about the migrants' allotment.
changed_reading.after: Their lack of inward claim is the load-bearing architecture of a community: walls and visible aggregation cannot substitute for an interior not occupied by rancor, fear, or competitive need.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love and preference become a test of whether kinship language survives cost. The contrasting group speaks brotherhood and promises aid under expulsion and fighting, but the sequence labels the claim false and shows withdrawal. In 59:9, ongoing love and self-displacing preference enact the relation precisely under privation.

activation_trace.role: Love abiding in the heart supplies the durable relation whose behavioral truth is tested.
Choosing another over oneself turns relational language into costly conduct.
Uttered speech supplies the verbal layer of a claimed solidarity awaiting enactment.
Brotherhood and kinship supply the named social bond whose reliability is under examination.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies the promised costly action.
Falsehood marks the fracture between asserted fraternity and conduct.
Turning away supplies the eventual motion that falsifies the earlier promise of accompaniment and aid.

structural_cues: 59:11 states conditional promises of accompaniment and aid to those called brothers; 59:12 negates both and ends in retreat, while 59:9's love and preference occur under actual shortage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship speech, promised aid, its designation as false, retreat, and costly preference. I infer that 59:9 defines truthful belonging by behavior under loss. A live alternative is a narrower contrast between two historical groups rather than a general mechanism of verified solidarity.

changed_reading.before: Love and generosity are two commendable traits of the hosts.
changed_reading.after: Love is verified as truthful belonging when it becomes aid and preference under real cost; unsupported brotherhood-talk is exposed by withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preferring others over one's selves is not self-annihilation. The later sequence asks a self to advance something for tomorrow, then depicts forgetting God as being made to forget one's own selves. This activates a temporal paradox: releasing the present self's possessive priority can preserve the accountable self across time, whereas retention can become self-forgetting.

activation_trace.role: The self as the thing's own identity anchors the difference between decentering immediate claim and erasing personhood.
Choosing another over the self supplies the present displacement of possessive priority.
Each self as its own accountable identity supplies continuity between present action and future encounter.
Advancing something ahead supplies the temporal transfer by which present action reaches tomorrow.
Loss of remembrance supplies the opposite process in which a self ceases to remain available to itself.
The forgotten selves make self-loss, rather than self-giving, the terminal danger.

structural_cues: 59:9 repeats self in preference and shuh; 59:18 makes a self send ahead for tomorrow; 59:19 makes neglect culminate in forgotten selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present self-decentering, provision advanced for tomorrow, and self-forgetting. I infer that relinquishing possessive priority can preserve rather than negate the self. A live alternative is that the later self-language concerns accountability independently of 59:9's redistribution.

changed_reading.before: Preferring others requires subordinating or denying the self.
changed_reading.after: The verse can distinguish the self from its possessive priority: decentering that priority may preserve the self's future integrity, while captive retention risks a deeper self-forgetting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive 'is guarded' can be read as enabled capacity rather than heroic self-conquest. The later cluster of safety, watchful care, and repair of fracture sharpens 59:9's sequence: a breached condition does not have to harden into shuh when the self is protected and its lack can be repaired.

activation_trace.role: Protection by an interposed guard anchors openness in received safeguarding rather than unaided willpower.
A breach in material condition supplies the lack that could otherwise trigger defensive retention.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the secure condition in which scarcity need not dictate closure.
Witnessing care and guardianship supply the sustaining oversight implied by being guarded.
Mending breakage and deficiency supplies repair as an alternative response to privation.

structural_cues: 59:9 links a breached condition to being guarded from shuh; 59:23 later clusters safety, guardianship, and the repair of fracture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies privation, passive safeguarding, safety, guardianship, and repair. I infer that protected and repairable lack enables generosity. A live alternative is that the later names orient divine attributes without specifying the psychosocial mechanism of 59:9.

changed_reading.before: Generosity under poverty demonstrates unusually strong self-control.
changed_reading.after: Openness under poverty may depend on being safeguarded and held within a reparative order, so lack is not forced to become defensive retention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links distant land, water, breach, and cultivation images rather than replacing the ordinary moral senses. It remains anchored in خَصَاصَة, شُحّ, and مُفْلِحُونَ and is activated by the packet's hard-mass/cracking sequence in 59:21. Downstream prose should mark it explicitly as a material analogy, not claim that the surface words literally denote soil engineering.

activation_trace.role: A gap or breach supplies a porous lack already present in the hosts' own condition.
Ground that retains its runoff supplies the material image of a self that arrests outward flow.
The cultivator who splits earth supplies flourishing as productive opening rather than accumulated closure.
Hardness that stops digging supplies the resistant mass against which inner opening becomes visible.
Cracking and opening hard matter supplies the reversal from sealed retention to cultivable permeability.

changed_reading.before: Flourishing is the reward for resisting stinginess despite a shortage.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, flourishing is the opening of a scarcity-hardened self: it ceases to retain all flow like resistant ground and becomes breachable, shareable, and cultivable.

strongest_changes: Settlement and faith became a deliberately prepared spatial-and-affective habitat that repairs displacement.
The lack of need in breasts became the inner architecture that makes gathering real, unlike walls around scattered hearts.
Love became verifiable solidarity under cost when contrasted with spoken brotherhood, false promises, and retreat.
The split ء ث ر-to-ث و ر mapping activated an exploratory model of preference as keeping returned resources in outward circulation.
Self-preference was revised from self-erasure to release of possessive priority that may preserve the accountable self across time.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah tightly couples habitat, interior state, distribution, scarcity, protection, and flourishing. Context changed these from separate virtues into mechanisms of counter-displacement, inner cohesion, tested solidarity, and protected openness; the packet's non-dominant ء ث ر mapping and land branches preserved unusually kinetic and material readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The ء ث ر-to-ث و ر movement model is packet-licensed but form-distant and should remain exploratory beside the dominant preference branch.
The safety-guardianship-repair cluster in 59:23 may orient rather than causally explain the passive safeguarding in 59:9.
The porous-ground model should not displace the direct syntax of poverty, preference, and flourishing; it is a contained cross-domain analogy.
